note: Editorial boundaries, hand-authored for Milestone 0. PRD §17 lists the pericope boundary source as open and docs/dataset-selection.md found no openly-licensed segmentation dataset (STEPBible's only sectioned Bible is CC BY-NC, which is excluded). Only the pericopes Milestone 0 generates are authored here; the rest of each book is deliberately absent. A psalm is its own pericope, and the range opens at verse 0 because the superscription is canonical text: 'A psalm of David' is part of what the reader is reading, not a heading above it.
